## Proto781M's Better Spawn 1.0.1

### Fixes

- `/gotodim` now follows the dimension's current global spawn when the template allows it.
- Added `parameters.allow_position_overwrite` (default `false`).
  Built-in Overworld, Nether, and End templates set it to `true`.
- Search methods use the new `center_x`/`center_z`; `fixed` and `platform` use the
  new coordinates; `portal_type` also updates its platform fallback position.
- Explicit position arguments in `--params` still override the probe for that run.

### Install

- Minecraft 1.21
- NeoForge 21.0.167+
- Java 21
- Put `betterspawn-1.0.1.jar` in the `mods` directory.

### Documentation

- Wiki: https://github.com/Nacano12345/MyBetterSpawnMod/wiki
